protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed two upstream libxml2 defects carried by packaged Nokogiri: CVE-2025-24928 is a stack overflow in valid.c xmlSnprintfElements because the old bounds checks did not account for prefix, colon, and local name together; CVE-2024-56171 is a use-after-free in xmlschemas.c because xmlSchemaItemListAdd can reallocate the items array while local dupls pointers remain stale. The upstream fixes 8c8753ad5280ee13aee5eec9b0f6eee2ed920f57 and 5880a9a6bd97c0f9ac8fc4f30110fe023f484746 directly repair those mechanisms.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed 131df0d6bf14a26f31c35f62de0d6b44f0328526 as the smallest public Nokogiri commit that first adds an affected libxml2 to the packaged build: its Rakefile adds libxml2-2.7.1.win32 to the downloaded externals and copies the resulting DLL into ext/nokogiri. The commit has one parent and is not a merge or squash aggregate. Earlier Nokogiri code already linked system libxml2 and exposed parser options, but that does not supersede this first-write for the vendor advisory's packaged-libxml2 scope.
